name: format-money
prompt: formatMoney in src/money.js prints -1234.5 dollars as "$-1234.50". Fix it: amounts are integer cents; the result has a thousands separator, two decimals, and the minus sign before the currency symbol (formatMoney(-123450) === "-$1,234.50", formatMoney(5) === "$0.05"). The optional second argument is the currency code: USD ($, the default), EUR (€) and GBP (£) put the symbol first; INR uses ₹. An unknown code throws an Error whose message names the code.
